body_text: 2026 Worldwide Rally Awards: Honoring Excellence Across The Domino’s Brand Published: June 16, 2026 Share Tweet Gilliard Chantre (Second from right) pictured alongside Domino’s U.S. President and COO, Joe Jordan; Domino’s CEO, Russell Weiner; and Domino’s Chief Restaurant Officer, Frank Garrido at Domino’s 2026 Worldwide Rally. Every two years, Worldwide Rally brings together franchisees, team members and leaders from around the globe to celebrate accomplishments, share ideas and recognize those who have made an outstanding impact on the brand. During the 2026 Worldwide Rally in Las Vegas, individuals and franchise organizations were recognized for their dedication, leadership and commitment to excellence. Among the highest honors presented was the Gold Franny Award, one of the most prestigious awards a Domino's franchisee can receive. For more than 40 years, the Gold Franny Award has recognized some of the best franchisees in the Domino's system. First introduced in 1982, the award honors franchisees who demonstrate exceptional operational performance, leadership and commitment to their teams, communities and fellow franchisees. The first Gold Franny recipients were Mack Patterson and Jeff Litmann, and the award continues to recognize an elite group of franchisees whose impact extends far beyond store performance. Only a small percentage of Domino's franchisees qualify to receive a Gold Franny Award. Recipients are recognized not only for delivering strong service, sales and store growth, but also for embodying Domino’s values and giving back to their communities and fellow franchisees. 2026 Gold Franny Award Recipients · Christopher Baum · Mason Burnham · Emily Elwell · Ommid Ferdows · Cassie Gerety · Dan Hosseini · Art Hurteau · Christopher Luttrell · Corey McKanna · Alex Melson · Becca Miller · Óscar Montemayor · Mike Nagengast · Sheldon Port · Marty Prather · John Powers · Fernando Salido · Chris Schlater · Dennis Schwesinger · Joe Sobran · Jason Teel · Ed Treacy · Todd Virgil · Drew Williams Team Member Awards While the Gold Franny Award recognizes an elite group of franchisees, there are several additional awards that celebrate outstanding team members and leaders whose contributions help drive the brand forward every day. Manager of the Year The Manager of the Year Award recognizes leaders who demonstrate excellence in operations, team development and store performance in the U.S. Regional Manager of the Year · Bryce Clark, Central Region · Emily Dunn, West Region U.S. & Regional Manager of the Year · Gilliard Chantre, East Region Rookie Manager of the Year The Rookie Manager of the Year Award recognizes emerging leaders who have made an immediate impact through strong performance and leadership. Regional Rookie Manager of the Year · Angela Haigis, Central Region · Bryan Ehrenzeller, East Region U.S. & Regional Rookie Manager of the Year · Alexandra Flynt, West Region Supervisor of the Year The Supervisor of the Year Award honors leaders who demonstrate exceptional support of their teams while driving operational success across multiple stores. Regional Supervisor of the Yea r · Bill Johnson, Central Region · Mike O'Brien, East Region U.S. & Regional Supervisor of the Year · Mike Lewis, West Region Delivery Expert of the Year The Delivery Expert of the Year Award recognizes team members who exemplify outstanding customer service, professionalism and dedication to the Domino's brand. Regional Delivery Expert of the Year · Destiny Weaver, Central Region · Carson Wohlfahrt, West Region U.S. & Regional Delivery Expert of the Year · George Fay, East Region The Chairman’s Circle Honor The Chairman’s Circle honors world-class franchisees and recognizes the longevity, growth, and leadership of the franchise. Such franchisees help teach, sponsor, and spread Domino's vision throughout the world. U.S. Chairman’s Circle Honorees · Art Hurteau and Marty Prather, Central Region International Chairman’s Circle Honoree · Aslan Saranga, DP Eurasia International Manager of the Year The International Manager of the Year Award recognizes leaders who demonstrate excellence in operations, team development, and store performance in international markets. International Manager of the Year · Xiaolian li, AMEA region Congratulations to All 2026 Award Recipients The accomplishments recognized at Worldwide Rally reflect the dedication, innovation and leadership that continue to drive Domino's forward. Congratulations to this year's recipients for their contributions to the brand, their teams and the communities they serve.
